Classical pilgrimage teaching places Arulmigu Dhandayuthapani Temple, Palani within India’s tirtha network: a location where devotion to Lord Murugan (Dhandayuthapani / Kartikeya) is believed to ripen vows more readily than in ordinary space. Epic, Puranic, and regional mahatmya literature — not a single uniform text — sustain this sense of sacred geography.
